action.summary: Review 5 clean, 12 injected-defect and 3 label-joined-rail native schematics with two local vision models, image-only (machine results withheld) and full
action.backend: native KiCad 10.0.6 + Ollama local vision models

artifacts.role: cases, machine checks, image hashes and every review decision
review brief sent to every model

checks.summary: With machine results withheld, Qwen rejected 5/5 clean and Devstral 5/5 clean schematics; both rejected all 15 defects. Rejection alone does not discriminate. Issues named the injected defect in 10/15 (Qwen) and 13/15 (Devstral) by keyword cue.

No defect that any machine gate fails was accepted: acceptance requires all independent checks, so detached-value, overlap, distant-reference and label-joined-rail defects caught by gates cannot be approved by either model.

Four injected defects pass every machine check (led_series detached value; three off-balance pages). Qwen in full mode accepted rc_highpass and rc_lowpass off-balance pages (system false acceptance reproduced). Measurement shows these pages are as off-centre (0.57 of half-frame) as the compiler's own clean output, mirrored; no composition gate exists.

blockers.summary: Page composition is ungated; compiler outputs and mirrored off-balance pages measure the same centring offset. Brief v2 labels 65% utilization an unqualified target.
blockers.next_action: Owner chooses a measurable page-composition criterion (e.g. centring/utilization bounds) to turn into an independent gate, or accepts composition as human-review-only.

blockers.summary: Defect-specific scoring uses keyword cues; no human readability assessment of the images was performed.
blockers.next_action: Owner or independent reviewer scores the retained images.

notes: Image-only mode still uses the standard system prompt, which tells the model to accept only when independent checks pass; withheld checks may bias toward rejection.
